Change.description:
One entry of the history: the version it made, who made it, what they
said about it and when.
Change.title: Change

CreateContest.description: A contest to make, titled `title` or, without one, its name.
CreateContest.title: CreateContest

CreateTask.description: A task to make, titled `title` or, without one, its name.
CreateTask.title: CreateTask

DefinitionError.description:
One thing wrong with a definition file: its YAML path, "" for the file
as a whole, and a sentence a form shows beside that field.
DefinitionError.title: DefinitionError

DraftSave.description:
A save kept as a draft: the version its files were written as, the
errors that kept it from publishing, and what it held back.
DraftSave.title: DraftSave

FileChange.description:
One file of a save, with the token it was read with, or null for a
file the save creates.
FileChange.title: FileChange

FileContent.description: One file at one version, with the token a write presents back.
FileContent.title: FileContent

GrantRequest.description:
Give the named user `role` at the scope, moving them from any other
role they hold directly there.
GrantRequest.title: GrantRequest

Holder.description:
Someone holding `role` at the scope asked about. `scope` is where
they hold it directly, and `inherited` is set when that is a broader
scope, such as an org admin listed at one of the org's contests.
Holder.title: Holder

Me.description:
The signed-in user and their roles at every scope. `degraded` is set
when the forge did not answer and the identity comes from the session.
Me.title: Me

NotReady.description:
Deliberately not a problem document: an orchestrator reads the status in
a fixed place. What failed underneath is in the log and not here.
NotReady.title: NotReady

Problem.description: Extra members are allowed: `sole_admin` carries `scopes`, for instance.
Problem.title: Problem

Provisioning.description:
How far making something has got. `steps` are the steps of its kind
in the order they run, and `last_step` is the last one that completed.
A failed record names the step it stopped at in `failed_step`, which is
none when the work failed outside any step, and says when it is tried
again, from where it stopped, in `retry_at`; both are none unless the
status is `failed`. `error` is the reason the last try failed, and
`attempts` counts the tries.
Provisioning.title: Provisioning

Publication.description:
One publication: its number among the task's publications, the version
it froze, whether it changed how the task grades and what, and when.
Publication.title: Publication

PublishedSave.description:
A save that published. `registration` says where the task's
registration for grading stands: `done` by this save, `pending` with the
poller, or `not_needed` because an earlier publication did it.
PublishedSave.title: PublishedSave

RollbackFile.description:
Write the file as it was at `version` back as a new change, `token`
being the one of the file as it is now.
RollbackFile.title: RollbackFile

SaveRequest.description:
The files a save writes, several at once. While the task's contest
runs, `confirm` publishes a change to how the task grades, and
`keep_as_draft` writes it as a draft that says what it held back; an
empty save with `confirm` publishes a draft kept that way.
SaveRequest.title: SaveRequest

SessionInfo.description:
One place this user is signed in, described by its device and its
times. The address a session came from is kept for the record and stays
out of the answer.
SessionInfo.title: SessionInfo

TaskRelease.description:
Whether the caller sees the task and may submit to it now, by the
server's clock: `released` once the contest is published and started,
the task's `release_at` has passed and it is not hidden; `visible` from
then until the contest is archived; `open` while visible, before the
contest's end plus the caller's own extension, with submissions not
closed. `closed` is the first reason it is not open.
TaskRelease.title: TaskRelease

TaskState.description:
Where a task's files stand: the version at their head, the latest
publication or none, and whether the head is a draft, a state no
publication froze. A draft carries the errors that keep it from
publishing; a draft with none was held back, or has not been saved since
it was made.
TaskState.title: TaskState

TreeEntry.description: A file or a folder directly under the folder asked about.
TreeEntry.title: TreeEntry

UpdateOrg.description: The org's description, and its display name when given.
UpdateOrg.title: UpdateOrg

WriteFile.description:
One file written, `token` being the one it was read with or null for
a new file. For a task this is a save, and `confirm` and
`keep_as_draft` do what they do for one.
WriteFile.title: WriteFile

Written.description: A contest's file written: the version the change made.
Written.title: Written
